name: Aloe Vera
tip: Let soil completely dry between waterings; soggy soil → root rot
Check: Leaves may wrinkle slightly if thirsty.

name: Anthurium
tip: Avoid water on leaves to prevent fungus; increase humidity if air is dry
Check: Leaves drooping → increase watering/humidity; yellowing leaves → overwatering.

name: Devils Ivy
tip: Thrives in low light; can tolerate occasional missed watering
Check: Leaves curling → underwatered; yellow leaves → overwatered.

name: Peace Lily
tip: Drooping leaves → water immediately; dont leave standing water
Check: Brown tips → too dry or low humidity

name: Pineapple Plant
tip: Avoid overwatering soil; ensure good drainage
Check: Dry outer leaves → water; mushy leaves → overwatered

name: Tradescantia
tip: Keep soil slightly moist, not soggy; well-draining pot
